notes.title: Update notes for July 15th, 2025 (Version 1.01, Bugfix Update)
notes.notes:
A small patch to clean up a few bugs, make the visuals more consistent, and make some minor balance adjustments.
   



Balance tweaks 

Reduced HP of Ghoul (16 -> 15)

Altered decks for tournament players (New decks added: Light Control, Blazing Dragon Maidens, Warrior Bloodlust. Ultimate Phoenix deck for Loveless made weaker)


Other fixes  

Fixed 'Best Pet Survey' crash bug (occured when None-type monster won the survey, gave out bugged None type tickets) 

Fixed visual errors (incorrect card display for Office Cup prize card, red gameboard with purple background)

Fixed play/discard requirements for Child Prince, Angel of Taboo, and Fallen Angel 

Minor dialogue tweaks 

Fixed issue where middle mouse button disabled menu UI
